fact: The Annuaire statistique 2024-2025 (edition 2025) of the technical and vocational education ministry presents statistics from its 2024-2025 census of formal TVET establishments, collected by questionnaires returned by heads of establishments, and the statistics quality committee validated it on 5 December 2025.
title: Annuaire statistique, Année scolaire 2024-2025
publisher: Ministère de l'Enseignement et de la Formation Techniques et Professionnels, Direction des Statistiques et de la Digitalisation
